rawVariants.cite: John Hudson and Edward Frlan, “Toward a Hierarchy of SDI Data Rates,” SMPTE Mot. Imag. J., 123(3): 17-40, Apr. 2014. First presented at IBC 2014, Amsterdam, The Netherlands, 11-15 September 2014. This paper is published here by kind permission of the IBC. Copyright © IBC. THE AUTHORS Pierre (Pete) Routhier, a former aerospace engineer, is a specialist in 3D and advanced imaging. As vice president of 3D strategy for Technicolor, he has developed innovative solutions and workflows to support major studios in the field of native 3D, CG 3D and 2D to 3D conversion and has worked on several Hollywood productions. He is currently focusing his research efforts on the acquisition of high-quality, advanced images, in the fields of high frame rate, high dynamic range, wide color gamut, and ultrahigh-definition, in partnership with major studios and broadcasters. Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero was born in Barcelona, Spain, 1989. He received a B.Sc. degree in sound and image engineering from the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), Spain, in 2010, and an M.Sc. degree in Telecommunication Engineering from UPC, Spain, in 2012. Since 2012, he has been working towards a Ph.D. within an agreement between Leibnitz Universität Hannover and Technicolor, both in Hannover, Germany. His research has been concerned with super-resolution upscaling, machine learning, and fast regression structures.
